title: Remote Control Funny Faces
tagline: Animate happy, silly, and surprised monster expressions on an 8x8 LED matrix!

phases.instructions: Locate the AX-1838HS IR receiver, IR transmitter remote controller, and MAX7219 8x8 dot matrix display module.
verificationCheckpoints: Pull clear plastic battery pull-tab out of IR remote

phases.instructions: Connect the MAX7219 SPI display lines (DIN, CS, CLK) and IR receiver data pin to Arduino.
verificationCheckpoints: DIN to Pin 12, CS to Pin 10, CLK to Pin 11
IR receiver signal to Pin 2 (hardware interrupt)
Shared 5V and GND rail connections intact

phases.instructions: Inspect SPI bus wiring carefully. Double-check that DIN, CS, and CLK pins are not swapped.
verificationCheckpoints: 5V and GND not reversed on IR sensor (reversing burns IR chip)

phases.instructions: Review how 8x8 bitmap arrays represent monster expressions (Happy, Surprised, Angry, Sleeping) and how IR hex codes swap expressions.
phases.codeExplanation:
- LedControl initializes the MAX7219 driver over SPI pins.
- byte happyFace[8] stores an 8x8 pixel bitmap where 1 turns an LED on and 0 turns it off.
- IrReceiver.decode() parses 38kHz infrared pulse bursts into clean command numbers.
- Pressing remote buttons selects and displays different emotional bitmap arrays.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand how 8 bytes map to 64 display pixels
Understand IrReceiver.resume() to listen for next click

phases.instructions: Upload sketch, point the handheld remote at the sensor, and press buttons 1 to 4 to animate hilarious monster faces!
Fantastic! You constructed an animated interactive display and mastered SPI and IR decoding.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Pixel Artist badge

story: Build an animated emotional monster face on a 64-pixel LED matrix that changes its mood and expression when you press buttons on an infrared handheld remote!

troubleshooting.cause: Clear plastic battery insulator is still inside remote
troubleshooting.solution: Pull out the plastic tab from the battery compartment at the base of the remote.
diagnosticSteps: Check if the transparent plastic battery tab is pulled from the IR remote.
Verify IR receiver signal wire is in digital pin 11.
